items.name: Mushroom Millets Whole Wheat Flour
items.subtitle: Secret of good health | Natural Wellness
items.summary: Prebiotic atta of Sonalika, Sharbati and Khapli wheat and millets, enriched with oyster mushroom powder.
items.description:
NABAGUNA Prebiotic Atta is meticulously crafted by blending premium Sonalika, Sharbati and ancient Khapli whole wheat grains, and Millets of enriched with the goodness of organic Oyster Mushroom powder.
These three wheats distinctive fusion introduces essential prebiotic dietary fibers along with high protein, other nutrients of the grains.
Millet is enriched of Bioactive carbohydrate (oligosaccharide and polysaccharide) protein and calcium and has more essential amino acids than most other cereals.
Oyster mushroom has protein and Prebiotic fiber which significantly enhances the nutritional profile of our Atta. It contains essential amino acids that our bodies are unable to produce on their own.
This dual action plays reducing the risk of infections and indigestion while nurturing the cultivation of beneficial gut microbes.
It is important to note the comprehensive health benefits of our Prebiotic Atta. However, individuals with known mushroom or wheat allergies are advised to avoid its consumption.
